title: MSC Reconciliation IV - MSC #5-#13 (January-September 2026)
headline: A reconciliation report proposes corrections to earlier monthly settlements for Spark, Grove, Osero and Obex, from a +536,094 USDS Sky-share adjustment for Spark to a -273,509 USDS supply-side adjustment for Obex.
summary: This report reconciles corrections to lending revenue, omitted investment income, borrowing-cost deductions and earlier settlement payments for Spark, Grove, Osero and Obex, covering monthly settlement cycles #5 to #13 (January to September 2026). Amounts already settled are excluded and published reports remain the baseline. All figures are in USDS. Supply-side adjustments: Spark +249,141.52, Grove +11,554.74, Osero 0, Obex -273,508.90. Sky-share adjustments: Spark +536,094.04, Grove -110,419.56. Osero gets a send-only refund of 5,514.00 that adds to the transfer without creating new debt. The method compares corrected historical results with the published reports; one correction fixes lending revenue for 139 allocation-months using actual deposit and withdrawal events. The report states its limits: complete independent daily asset checks remain deferred, it does not certify a full monthly ALM transfer review, and the bridge analysis covers four Ethereum routes, not all. Calculation inputs and scripts are published at a named commit. The adjustments feed into the October settlement (MSC #14).
